audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits: Qiyana wins pre-6 energy-starved trades, Zed owns 6-through-first-item with Death Mark, Qiyana outscales at 2+ items. 53.97% WR over 2518 games.
Spikes are right and specific: pre-6 short trades, level 6 Zed spike, first item still Zed-favoured, 2+ items swing back. All 4 spike entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' while the content win[] (Q,Q,Q,Q,Zed,Zed,Q) and the packet levelChart agree on real verdicts — the two layers disagree on all 7 rows. phases[4].why and phases[5].why described Qiyana winning stages the content correctly gives to Zed. The missing untargetable interaction (Zed is untargetable during Death Mark's dash) was nowhere on the page, and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit.
audit.why: Zed R Death Mark 120/110/100s with untargetability on the dash; W Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16s; Q 6s. Qiyana's R knockup cannot hit him mid-dash — the answer goes after the mark lands.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content/packet, Zed-row whys rewritten to match, untargetable interaction folded into cooldowns, real numbers added.

audit.why: R 120/110/100s and W 20s rank 1 are the two windows the lane is scheduled around.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: New bodies written to match their titles.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Terrashape (element swap) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark (R): 120/110/100s — untargetable during the dash, so spend your answer AFTER the mark lands, never into it. - His W Living Shadow runs 20s early: no shadow, no combo — that is your window. - Budget your W for emergencies, your R for opportunities.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Break line of sight in grass after each E-Q — his 6s Q needs vision to land, and the next trade starts before he re-finds you.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Open ground is his W-R arena — the 20s shadow gives him the gap-close and escape your terrain would have denied.

edits.before: Supreme Display online — any fight near a wall is a stun lottery you rigged. Hug terrain like rent depends on it.
edits.after: Death Mark plus double-shadow Q one-shots you — he is untargetable on the dash, so answer after the mark lands.

edits.before: First item spike: the full element string deletes squishies. Force the brush-line fights.
edits.after: His lethality spike keeps the R combo lethal — concede the duel, farm, and scale to two items.

notes: Content win[] and the packet levelChart agree on all 7 rows (Qiyana 0-3, Zed 4-5, Qiyana 6), and the content whys explain each verdict from the kit — so the full layer's blanket 'Skill' was the wrong side of the disagreement and was aligned to them; no content edits needed (win[] already correct, no-ops rejected). phases[4-5].why rewritten because the old text described Qiyana winning stages now marked Zed. Missing interaction (untargetable-dodges-burst) landed in breakdown.cooldowns and phases[4].why. Zed is male — no pronoun issues. Ratings flipped to 4/10 on Zed rows to match the side; enum fields are band-exempt.
